title: 005 通天塔006 转正待遇
content_zh:
握着通天塔，许临东神色凝重。
转移诅咒不能有丝毫差错。
若是处理不当，诅咒很可能逸散侵入附近的普通人体内，引发新的尸变，到头来还得他来收拾。
通常，序列超凡者会将被镇压的邪物上交神异司，借助局内的神异物进行封禁。
但他拥有通天塔，就可以直接处理。
尽管现在他手中的通天塔已是残缺状态，需要耗费心力积累功德，慢慢修复，但其价值依旧不可估量。
随着他“抬杠”
的动作。
灶神轿内的诅咒力量顿时被引向通天塔的方向，眨眼间便被塔体吸纳，消失不见。
红灯笼内摇曳的火光迅速稳定下来。
许临东心念微动，意识紧跟着沉入了通天塔之中。
下一刻。
他如同陷入一场无比清晰的梦境。
意识倏然坠入一个熟悉而又神秘的黑色空间。
这里正是通天塔的最底层大厅。
塔内空间广阔，青灰色的塔壁透出幽幽光泽，浮雕上的山川河岳纹路在塔身能量流转下泛着微光。
他的目光环顾一周。
却见塔身除了背后的正门方位，东西北三个方位，分别竖立有三扇古朴石门。
门楣上分别铭刻“天道”
“地道”

“人道”
的篆文。
在三扇石门旁，还分别存在不同的黑色小门，显得很神秘。
此时，“地道”
大门正微微震颤，隐约还有丝丝阴冷黑气残留，很快又吸入了门内。
与他先前送走的那缕诅咒力量气息如出一辙。
“果然已经关进去了……”
许临东心中了然。
那诅咒的力量虽然厉害，但进了通天塔内，就无法逞凶了，已被塔内规则镇压，暂时无害。
不过，这疑似是地道序列八阴差的诅咒力量，竟是关押在通天塔的最底层第十层，似乎有些不合常理。
“可能是这股诅咒力量还很微弱......如果是那件邪异物本身，也许就会直接关进第八层。”
他目光转向前方大厅中央。
那里有一面高约两米的椭圆形铜镜静静矗立。
却见镜框雕纹，左侧嵌星辰运转的天道图腾，右侧刻山峦叠嶂的地道纹路，上方则浮雕书卷展开的人道铭文。
镜面本是如蒙灰水波。
但在他注视的瞬间骤然澄澈，化作通透水晶，映出他清晰的身影。
镜面涟漪微荡，一行行泛着金光的字迹浮现出日志的情况：
content_en:
Holding the Tower of Babel, Xu Lindong looked solemn.
There can be no mistakes in transferring the curse.
If it is not handled properly, the curse is likely to escape and invade the bodies of nearby ordinary people, causing new corpse transformations, and he will have to deal with it in the end.
Normally, Sequence Transcendents would hand over the suppressed evil objects to the Department of Mysteries, and use the bureau's supernatural objects to ban them.
But since he owns the Tower of Babel, he can handle it directly.
Although the Tower of Babel in his hands is now in a incomplete state and requires effort to accumulate merit and repair slowly, its value is still immeasurable.
Follow him to "raise the bar"
action.
The cursed power in the Kitchen Shrine was immediately directed towards the Tower of Babel, and in the blink of an eye it was absorbed by the tower and disappeared.
The flickering firelight in the red lantern quickly stabilized.
Xu Lindong's thoughts moved slightly, and his consciousness immediately sank into the Tower of Babel.
The next moment.
He seemed to have fallen into an extremely clear dream.
His consciousness suddenly fell into a familiar and mysterious black space.
This is the lowest hall of Babel Tower.
The space inside the tower is vast, the blue-grey tower walls reveal a faint luster, and the mountains and rivers patterns on the reliefs shimmer under the energy flow of the tower body.
His eyes looked around.
However, in addition to the main entrance behind the tower, there are three simple stone doors erected in three directions: east, west, north and west.
The lintels are inscribed with the words "Tiandao" respectively.
"authentic"
"Humane"
of seal script.
Next to the three stone doors, there are different small black doors, which look very mysterious.
At this time, "authentic"
The door was trembling slightly, and there was still a faint trace of cold black air remaining, which was quickly sucked into the door again.
It was exactly the same as the breath of cursed power he sent away before.
"Sure enough, they have been locked up..."
Xu Lindong understood clearly.
Although the power of the curse is powerful, once it enters the Tower of Babel, it cannot be evil. It has been suppressed by the rules in the tower and is temporarily harmless.
However, it seems a bit unreasonable that this cursed power, which is suspected to be the eight yinza of the authentic sequence, is actually imprisoned on the tenth floor of the Babel Tower.
"Maybe the power of this curse is still very weak... If it were the evil foreign object itself, it might be imprisoned directly on the eighth floor."
He turned his gaze to the center of the hall ahead.
There is an oval bronze mirror about two meters high standing quietly.
But there are carvings on the frame, with the heavenly totem inlaid with stars rotating on the left side, the authentic pattern of mountains on the right side, and the human inscriptions of an unfolded scroll embossed on the top.
The mirror surface is like gray water waves.
But the moment he looked at it, it suddenly became clear and turned into transparent crystal, reflecting his clear figure.
The ripples on the mirror rippled slightly, and lines of golden writing appeared in the log:
